title: 5 EASY Latin DANCE STEPS You NEED [STEP BY STEP] Beginners

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains foundational Latin dance posture before breaking down individual steps with progressive layering. She counts her movements clearly and demonstrates variations for different music styles.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to Latin dance steps and what will be covered
Explanation of fundamental posture, weight placement, and knee bending
Breakdown of the first dance step: Heels in & out
Adding body movements and level-ups to the first step
Practicing the first step and variations with music
Breakdown of the second dance step: Side to side
Breakdown of the third dance step: Three Side Steps
Breakdown of the fourth dance step: Forward & Back
Breakdown of the fifth dance step: Back steps

metaphors: bend your knees, please don't stretch it cause this is gonna block your whole body
common_mistakes: stretching knees which blocks the body
safety: relax your knees and relax your butt

steps_taught.name: Heels in & out
steps_taught.description: Moving heels in and out while shifting weight between legs

steps_taught.name: Side to side
steps_taught.description: Opening and closing feet from side to side

steps_taught.name: Three Side Steps
steps_taught.description: Taking three steps to the side with a touch on the fourth count

steps_taught.name: Forward & Back
steps_taught.description: Stepping forward and back while shifting weight

steps_taught.name: Back steps
steps_taught.description: Opening and closing steps moving towards the back

what_hinders: multiple changes of rhythm and style within a short span

quotes.text: The first thing you need to know to dance any Latin rhythm is to go with your whole weight to the front.
Now if you want to take this movement to the next level, add a little bit more of hip movement to the dance.
If you want to take this dance step to the next level, we're gonna add hip movement and torso movement.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates correct versus incorrect knee posture with visual overlays.
Step-by-step breakdown of heel movement with weight shifts.
Practicing the steps to music at increasing speeds.
Inset video showing close-up of feet during side steps.
Demonstrating incorrect arm placement with a black and white filter.

extraction.distinctive_method: Progressively layering body movements like hips, chest, and shoulders onto simple footwork patterns across multiple Latin rhythms.
